name: Tower of Power
description: The most iconic and talked-about ride in any water park in the world. A near-vertical transparent freefall slide that plunges riders from 28 metres at breakneck speed directly through a lagoon filled with sharks, stingrays and tropical fish. The transparent tube section means you see the sharks swimming just centimetres from your body as you shoot through at over 80 km/h. Terrifying, exhilarating and utterly unforgettable — Tower of Power is the reason people visit Siam Park.

name: The Dragon
description: A spectacular ProSlide CannonBowl ride that sends riders hurtling into the jaws of a giant dragon before dropping into an enormous spinning funnel bowl. The sensation of zero gravity as you circle the inside of the bowl is unlike anything else in water park riding — riders are flung from one side to the other before being swallowed by the drain. One of the most intense and physically demanding water rides in Europe.

name: Wave Palace
description: The largest artificial wave pool in the world and Siam Park's crown jewel — a World Record holder generating waves of up to three metres that you can actually surf. The Wave Palace holds 15,000 square metres of water heated to 24 degrees and draws enormous crowds. Whether you ride the surf, bodyboard on the waves or simply float in the warm water on Siam Beach, this is the centrepiece of the entire park experience.

name: Mai Thai River
description: One of the world's longest lazy rivers at over 600 metres, winding at the highest elevation of any lazy river on earth at 8 metres above ground. Riders float through lush tropical landscaping, past cascading waterfalls and through a spectacular aquarium filled with tropical fish and sharks before the journey's end. At its conclusion, an optional diversion sends riders up a lift into a final slide for those wanting one last thrill.

name: The Giant
description: Twin ProSlide CannonBowl 40 rides side by side — one spinning clockwise, one counterclockwise — sending riders in giant rubber rings through enormous bowl funnels. The Giant is Siam Park's most exhilarating group ride, perfect for two riders who want to compete as they spin in opposite directions at terrifying speed before plunging into the exit pool together.

name: The Volcano
description: A thrilling dark ride through the heart of a tropical volcano combining complete darkness with dramatic mist effects and stunning light shows. Riders descend through the crater of the volcano aboard rubber rings, surrounded by rumbling sounds and atmospheric effects that recreate the sensation of being swallowed by a living volcano. A unique experience that blends spectacle with genuine water slide thrills.

name: Jungle Snakes
description: Four individual ProSlide PipeLine tube slides — Cobra, Boa, Viper and Python — winding through the park's tropical terrain like enormous snakes through the jungle. Two are standard PipeLine slides and two are high-speed Turbo PipeLine versions for extra adrenaline. The perfect ride for groups who want to race each other down four parallel snaking tubes through lush tropical scenery.

name: Mekong Rapids
description: A ProSlide Mammoth four-person family raft ride delivering the excitement of white water river rapids in a themed tropical setting. The whole family rides together in circular rafts through twisting water channels, drops and splashing waves. One of the most social and accessible rides in the park, suitable for families with children of all ages.

name: Naga Racer
description: A six-lane ProSlide racing mat slide where the whole family grabs a mat and launches simultaneously down parallel lanes to see who reaches the bottom first. With six lanes to compete, Naga Racer is the most fun and sociable competitive ride in the park — simple, fast, and endlessly rerideable as families argue over who really won.

name: Kinanaree
description: A 200-metre long water hybrid ride slide — one of the newest additions to Siam Park — delivering three experiences in one thrilling journey. Combining open sections, enclosed tubes and dramatic speed changes across its full length, Kinanaree is packed with surprises and curves that make each run feel different from the last.

name: Bodhi Trail
description: An exciting aerial adventure trail suspended above the park where guests tackle a series of challenges, zip lines and obstacle courses with panoramic views over Siam Park's spectacular Thai-themed landscape and the Tenerife coastline beyond. A unique dry attraction within the water park offering a completely different type of adventure for those who want a break from the slides.

name: Sawasdee
description: A dedicated children's water play fortress with 24-degree heated water, four different child-sized slides, bridges, waterfalls and countless splash features designed specifically for younger guests. Sawasdee is a safe, supervised and endlessly fun environment where children can experience all the excitement of Siam Park's biggest rides in perfectly scaled-down form.

name: The Lost City
description: A vast children's adventure fortress with over 120 interactive water games, slides, cannons, buckets and tipping features set within a magnificently themed ancient lost civilisation. The most extensive children's water play structure in any European water park, beloved by families as the one attraction where parents and young children can play together for hours.

name: Sea Lions Show
description: A charming sea lion show at the park entrance featuring trained sea lions in an educational and entertaining performance. A popular attraction for families with young children offering a relaxed alternative to the water rides and a chance to see these impressive marine animals up close.
